title: salix caprea var. angustifolia
intro: Salix caprea var. angustifolia, commonly known as the narrow-leaved goat willow, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Salicaceae family. It is a variant of the goat willow (Salix caprea), characterized by its narrower leaves. The narrow-leaved goat willow has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering health benefits such as reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating inflammation. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, salicin, and salicylic acid, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic properties.
